name: Fallen Sky Lords
label: Quest
description: Fallen Sky Lords: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our air support is in shambles, friend. The Wing Commanders were shot down over enemy territory. You must find out what became of them so that we can attempt a rescue!
Guse was last seen flying over the Icewing Bunker. Jeztor's War Rider was spotted near the Stormpike lumber mill. Mulverick... That reckless fool was seen crashing near the Dun'Baldar North Bunker.
That's all the information I have. Move out! Search through the areas thoroughly.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done! The information you recovered will be invaluable to our cause.
